title: About Me
text:
I have a Master of Science in Computer Science from the University of Texas at Arlington, where I studied various aspects of computer science, such as open source and standards, data structures, algorithms, and software engineering. I am currently a Software Development Engineer at Amazon Web Services (AWS), where I develop and test cloud-based solutions for various customers and services.
At AWS, I have contributed to the development of a new Change Tracking micro-service, which helps customers audit their compliance process, as well as the automation of the launch of the Systems Manager service in multiple regions, expanding its availability and accessibility. I have also worked on several operational projects that reduced the operational burden on the team drastically. I have demonstrated strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail, as well as proficiency in MySQL, PHP, Git, and other technologies. I am passionate about creating innovative and scalable solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and user experience. I value collaboration, learning, and feedback, and I strive to bring diverse perspectives and experiences to the team.
